Nora (People Ops): Hey payroll, Carlos got his relocation stipend but it was marked non-taxable in the March run. Can someone check?
Ethan (Payroll): Can you share run id and emp id? Ill pull it.
Nora (People Ops): Run pr-2026-03-20-07, emp 50721. Paystub shows 
`Relocation Stipend 1500.00 non-taxable`
Carlos Mendez: It was housing support while in Spain for 4 weeks. I selected 'assignment stipend' on the form.
Priya (HR Ops): We changed the stipend mapping last month; older submissions sometimes keep old flags.
Ethan (Payroll): Got it. Payroll import flagged 1 mismatch. Ill reclassify and run an off-cycle calc, then post expected withholding.
TaxBot: Note: if reclassification changes annual wages we may need a W-2c. Flagging tax counsel if totals change.
Carlos Mendez: Thanks  appreciate it.
Nora (People Ops): Please cc me on the ticket and include any net-pay impact so we can communicate to Carlos."
